title: Is the gap within the tolerance?
heading: The Report Is the Verdict, and Optimal Means Within the Gap Tolerance
cases: a maximization 0.05% from its bound passes a 0.1% tolerance
a maximization 0.2% from its bound fails a 0.1% tolerance
with an integral objective, a bound of 41004.6 counts as 41004, which brings the gap under 0.01%
for a minimization the bound is rounded up, 40995.4 to 40996, never down
